packaging.deployment: Use the existing Flex app's supported OneDeploy/config-zip path with remote build disabled; do not create another server or add legacy WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE settings.
packaging.extensionBundle: Microsoft.Azure.Functions.ExtensionBundle [4.*, 5.0.0); platform host may download its Microsoft binding bundle.
packaging.hostAndDeploymentStorage: Infrastructure must configure authenticated host/deployment storage; storage credentials never belong in frontend assets.

api.authorization: GET/POST/PUT require Authorization: Bearer <canonical unpadded base64url encoding of exactly 32 bytes>; incoming x-melzi-* and x-ms-* owner headers are ignored.

additionalAppSettings.ALLOWED_ORIGINS: <comma-separated exact canonical HTTPS origins, with no trailing slash>

api.corsOwner: application entry only; leave platform App Service CORS empty/disabled and EasyAuth disabled

housekeeping.trigger: timer only; no HTTP function registration

additionalAppSettings.API_RESOURCE_ID: <exact separate API app ARM resource ID>

housekeeping.manualInvocation: Parent may use the Azure host admin endpoint with a privately held master key; never add an HTTP trigger for this purpose.

migration.lifecycle: Temporary separate app only; invoke using a privately held function/host key and delete the app after successful migration.

verification.armQuota: Pass the signed quotaSnapshot as snapshot; sets requests=9999 without invoking admission or ARM. Then hit the REAL API to prove its worker persists auto_closed before self-stop.
verification.counterProof: observed_invocations increments before every executing public request, even exhausted ones. After ARM Stopped, HTTP probes must leave observed_invocations unchanged; capped requests=10000 alone is insufficient proof.
verification.snapshotRestoration: Signed snapshots include observed_invocations along with requests/writes/creates/auto_closed. Restore rejects changed state and UTC rollover and restores only current/prior day metadata.
verification.lifecycle: Temporary separate app using app DB credentials only; function-key authenticated; remove after guarded fixture/quota cleanup.

safetyNotes: Do not set or copy platform-injected identity endpoint/header values; code only accepts loopback or link-local identity destinations and exact public-cloud ARM site resource IDs.
PostgreSQL TLS uses rejectUnauthorized=true, exact server hostname and the Node default trust store; Azure artifacts contain no RDS CA bundle.

Azure quota closure commits before ARM stop while a five-second bounded session advisory lock serializes timer reopening. A failed/ambiguous stop is retried on later exhausted invocations even if auto_closed is already true.
The cutoff request returns daily_limit 429 if its worker survives; real self-stop may terminate its response. Client must retain pending mutation identity and local data.

Only prior-day quota markers may auto-reopen. Failed/ambiguous reopening is best-effort stopped again with no automatic retry marker. Disable the timer before manual/emergency stops and diagnose overlapping stop causes.

No reliance on dailyMemoryTimeQuota for Flex. Instance limits, counters and stop calls are not absolute spending caps; propagation, in-flight work and ancillary storage/database/network billing remain.
